description: Inventario de Presas y Embalses is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Inventory of dams and reservoirs in Spain, where you can consult their geographical location, data on the basin, reservoir capacities, status of safety documents and technical data of dams and photographs and plans thereof. Coverage: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. The portal shows the English title as "Inventory of Dams and Reservoirs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Its keywords include inundación, Energía, abastecimiento, regadío, infraestructura hidráulica, presa. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.magrama.gob.es/es/atencion-al-ciudadano/aviso-legal.aspx). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
